WITH Rolling_Window AS
(
SELECT * FROM
    (
    SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Business_Day_Flag ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC) AS RN
    ,* 
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM
        INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
            ON FULLDATE <= CRM_DATE
    WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
    ) A
WHERE
--- Last n business days
    RN <= Rolling_Window
)

, test AS
(
SELECT
RW.FullDate AS AS_OF_DATE,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.PREFERREDFLAG,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.PHONEOREMAIL,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.PHONEEMAILTYPE,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.PHONENOCITYCODE,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.PHONENOLOCALCODE,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.WORKEXTENSION,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.DONOTDISTURB,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.DATEOFREQUEST,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.LAST_UPDATED_DATE,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.EMAIL,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.PHONEEMAILID,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.BANK_ID,
CRM_PHONEEMAIL.ORGKEY
FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
    LEFT JOIN eds.CRM_PHONEEMAIL AS CRM_PHONEEMAIL
        ON CRM_PHONEEMAIL.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
        AND SUBSTRING(CRM_PHONEEMAIL.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
---Fetch all records that per business day (snapshot)
        AND ((RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA = 'Snapshot' AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN CRM_PHONEEMAIL.SCD_Start_Date AND CRM_PHONEEMAIL.SCD_End_Date)
            OR (RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA = 'Delta' AND RW.FullDate = CRM_PHONEEMAIL.SCD_Start_Date))
)
SELECT AS_OF_DATE, COUNT(*) CNT FROM test
GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE
ORDER BY AS_OF_DATE DESC
